title: Ideogram v4 Instant and Fast variants were recorded
summary: On 2026-07-14, the dated link set added fal-hosted Ideogram v4 variants labelled Instant and Fast. This is a material development step because it identifies distinct variants within the Ideogram 4 line. The links alone do not establish their availability, technical differences, or exact relationship to the June distributions.
research_notes: `ideogram-v4-instant` is an 8-step BF16 pre-QAD checkpoint, while `ideogram-v4-fast` is a 20-step FP4/QAD checkpoint. Both are fal-developed from Ideogram’s FP8 base and remove runtime CFG.
